name: now-playing-glass
description: A presentational React "now playing" widget — an album disc that taps open into a Dynamic-Island-style glass card (shared-element cover morph, equalizer, ambient backdrop, marquee). Bring your own data source (Last.fm, Spotify, Apple Music…).

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --external:react --external:framer-motion --format=esm --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.js --banner:js="'use client';" && esbuild src/index.js --bundle --external:react --external:framer-motion --format=cjs --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.cjs --banner:js="'use client';" && cp src/styles.css dist/styles.css && cp src/index.d.ts dist/

author: kv
